paths.name: The year’s syllabus
paths.why: It starts with working alongside agents and how nature coordinates without a manager. It then looks at what systems emit, how to see hardness in failures and successes, and how to engineer it. It ends with how industries keep that hardness alive, set against business process re-engineering.

movements.name: Working alongside agents
movements.blurb: Agency law, field studies and recent incidents show what agents can see and do, and what changes in the work and roles of the people beside them.

movements.name: Natural coordination
movements.blurb: Cells coordinate through thresholds, feedback and a small conserved core with wide variety at the edges.

movements.name: Emissions
movements.blurb: What systems publish for others to act on: files, logs, events, confidential reports and required disclosures.

movements.name: Seeing hardness
movements.blurb: Investigations of failures and of successes show where hardness held, where it was missing, and where it cracked. Each failure is paired with a success that runs on a similar mechanism.

movements.name: Engineering hardness
movements.blurb: Guardrails built into the architecture, from end-to-end design to modular design rules, checklists and signed mandates for agents.

movements.name: Operational liveness
movements.blurb: How industries keep amending their protocols, read against re-engineering’s clean slate.
